entries.name: Eroseanna Robinson

expected.judge: U.S. District Judge Edwin A. Robson, Northern District of Illinois
expected.sentence:
One year and one day; released early after approximately three months following a sustained hunger strike

Charges as recorded: Contempt of court for refusing to pay federal income taxes for 1954–1958 and refusing to turn over financial records to the IRS

entries.rationale: The editorial introduction to Robinson’s own account in the October 1960 Catholic Worker, page 1, distinguishes the January 27 indefinite contempt order from the February 18 year-and-a-day sentence. It also confirms the existing January 26 arrest and May 20 unconditional release. Fill only the missing sentencing date; preserve all existing biography and case prose.
